children: TORONTO, CANADA, October 19, 2026 – TheNewswire - ONEnergy Inc. (“ONEnergy” or the “Company”) (NEX: OEG.H) announces that it has closed its non-brokered private placement on October 16, 2026, previously announced on October 5, 2026 (the "Offering").
Under the Offering, the Company issued 4,000,000 common shares of the Company (each, a "Share") at a price of $0.05 per Share for gross proceeds of $200,000.
No commissions or finders' fees are payable by the Company in connection with the Offering.
The Company intends to use the net proceeds of the Offering for general corporate and working capital purposes.
The Shares issued pursuant to the Offering are subject to a statutory hold period of four months and one day from the applicable closing date of the Offering.

The securities have not been and will not be registered under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “U.S. Securities Act”), or any state securities laws, and may not be offered or sold, within the United States, unless exemptions from the registration requirements of the U.S. Securities Act and applicable state securities laws are available.

The Offering has been conditionally approved by the TSX Venture Exchange (“TSXV”), but completion of the Offering remains subject to the receipt of all necessary regulatory approvals, including approval of the TSXV.

No securities regulatory authority has reviewed or approved of the contents of this news release. This news release does not constitute an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any securities of ONEnergy in any jurisdiction in which such offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful.

ONEnergy common shares are listed on the NEX board of the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol “OEG.H”. Material information about ONEnergy can be found on SEDAR+ under the Company’s issuer profile at www.sedarplus.ca. ONEnergy’s corporate website may be found at www.onenergyinc.com.
Ray de Ocampo, Chief Financial Officer, irinfo@onenergyinc.com, +1 (647) 253-2534
